title: Yo Phone Linging
blurb: Mispronunciation carries this entire meme, and it is doing an enormous amount of work. Announcing that your phone is ringing needs no announcement at all, so taking the most redundant sentence available and shouting it through several layers of compression counts as a sound comic strategy. Set it as an actual ringtone if you are brave. Play it whenever somebody's phone goes off in a quiet public place, or use it to flag a call that should very obviously not be answered. Linging intensifies.
origin: A viral deep-fried 'your phone ringing' announcement clip.
